textRuns.value: Beyond the Empire | Uncalibrated historical model scores from held-out rows (98 rows, 6 contractions). A polity is a historical political unit. A score ranks rows; it is not a probability. Explanations describe the model, not causes of history. No modern-country or transfer claims. Select exactly one polity and one year for a single score; the score card stays blank on multi-row selections by design.
